; Managed by the Jupiter Bot AMP template.
; This server is the RenX section. Add another server as another section and list it on Servers.

Servers=RenX

[RenX]
Hostname=
Port=7777
Password=
ChanType=1
AdminChanType=2
CommandPrefix=!
Rules=Respect other players.
ReconnectDelay=10000
MaxReconnectAttempts=-1
RCONBan=false
LocalSteamBan=true
LocalIPBan=true
LocalHWIDBan=true
LocalRDNSBan=false
LocalNameBan=false
NeverSay=false
ResolvePlayerRDNS=true
ClientUpdateRate=2500
BuildingUpdateRate=7500
PingUpdateRate=60000
PingTimeoutThreshold=10000

UpdateSourceArgs: -c "mkdir -p /tmp/xdg-runtime && chmod 700 /tmp/xdg-runtime; export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/xdg-runtime WINEPREFIX=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.wine\" WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all WINEDLLOVERRIDES=\"mscoree,mshtml=\"; if [ -f \"$WINEPREFIX/system.reg\" ]; then echo \"Wine prefix already exists, skipping wineboot\"; wineserver -k >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit 0; fi; timeout --signal=KILL 180 /usr/bin/xvfb-run -a /usr/bin/wineboot --init --update; status=$?; if [ \"$status\" -eq 124 ] || [ \"$status\" -eq 137 ]; then echo \"wineboot timed out, continuing\"; wineserver -k >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit 0; fi; exit \"$status\""
